ev_0006.summary: Figure: circle centered at O (424.6,686.1), radius about 352.7 px, with diameter AB on the horizontal line y=688 (A at x=71.9, B at x=777.3, so OA=OB=r). Only the upper semicircle is drawn. C (174.5,437.4) lies on the circle and on radius OC (45 deg, solid). D (472.1,98.4) is at the top of the figure but NOT on the circle: OD is about 590 px long, far larger than r. Segment OD runs from O through the unlabeled point P (453.1,334.5), which lies on the circle near its top, and continues to D. Segment CB runs from C to B and crosses OD at X1 (436.1,546.5). Segment DC runs from D through C and ends near Q (143.4,473.1), which also lies on the circle. All five drawn segments (AB, OD, DC, CB, OC) are solid. Detect_right_angle_marker verified no right-angle marks, so none are submitted.
